text: If a man has lost a leg or an eye, he knows he has lost a leg or an eye; but if he has lost a self—himself—he cannot know it, because he is no longer there to know it.
author: Oliver Sacks
work: The Man Who Mistook His Wife for a Hat
visual_brief: A precise engineering schematic of an optical sensor assembly or interferometer, showing light paths reflecting through a series of precision prisms and mirrors toward a central receiver socket that is rendered entirely in faint, dashed ghost lines around an empty void. Fine dimension callouts and dashed alignment axes cross at the missing focal point.
alt: Engineering schematic of an optical sensor loop converging on an empty void
